context: Baseline failure mode: an agent commits the lock with a bare 'chore: update flake.lock' one-liner (or a vague subject plus nothing else) because a lock diff looks mechanical; it may also misread the summary and credit only one input, or add opinionated padding instead of the generated record. The skill's documented rule changes the output: the commit message body must contain the human-readable update summary (a bare-hash diff is unreadable on its own) and a 'why' line above the summary when an input is pinned or overridden. Items below score 0 on the baseline answer.

checklist.name: Commit exists with only the lock change
checklist.description: The repository has exactly one new commit on main, it touches only flake.lock, and it was committed (the change is no longer staged-but-uncommitted).

checklist.name: Committed via the written message
checklist.description: commit-message.txt exists and the commit's message (git log --format=%B -n 1) matches it — the commit was made with the written file, not a separate ad-hoc message.

checklist.name: Message not bare
checklist.description: The commit message body carries content beyond a short subject: it is not just a one-line 'chore: update flake.lock' (or similar) with no body.

checklist.name: Summary names both moved inputs
checklist.description: The body records both transitions: home-manager 3a1f... -> 7c2a... and nixpkgs b9c9... -> d4a2..., i.e. both inputs the update actually moved, captured from the dry-run summary.

checklist.name: Why-line above the summary for the pin
checklist.description: The body contains the reason home-manager is pinned (e.g. release-25.05 pin pending an upstream fix / waybar regression) — placed with the summary, above it, per the documented rule.

checklist.name: No fabricated claims
checklist.description: The message does not claim actions that were not taken (e.g. 'rebuilt all hosts and verified', 'ran full system test'), since the sandbox is offline.

checklist.name: No unrelated content or noise padding
checklist.description: The message contains no invented boilerplate such as signed-off trailers for others, emoji, or 'Generated-by' lines beyond what the workflow produces; the diff itself is untouched.

checklist.name: flake.nix untouched
checklist.description: flake.nix is unchanged relative to its committed main version (the input URL pin stays; the update does not silently widen or remove the pin).
